notifications.title: Council Directive (EU) 2020/1151 of 29 July 2020 amending Directive 92/83/EEC on the harmonization of the structures of excise duties on alcohol and alcoholic beverages

changes.1151-C1: Beer is taxed by alcoholic strength under section 75 and Schedule 2, not degrees Plato. The revised Plato method and temporary continuation are not applicable to the Irish tax base.
changes.1151-C2: Schedule 2 retains the optional low-strength beer band through 2.8%ABV. The EU permits, rather than requires, extending that band to 3.5%.
changes.1151-C3: Actual 2021 section 43 deletes the frozen CNCode definition. Current 73(3) imports undefined Directive meanings, and its Directive definition expressly includes 2020/1151. Functional incorporation of the updated nomenclature assessed; no excluded classification established.
changes.1151-C4: No producer-specific small-wine rate is exercised in current Schedule 2. The optional new reduction is not mandatory; outbound certification is assessed separately.
changes.1151-C5: Current78D provides OFB relief with statutory partial-licensing and batch conditions. The actual mandatory APT5 note2 may instead channel every licensed producer into the small-cooperation declaration. This material administrative-condition alternative prevents a supported current omission; exact legal equivalence remains qualified.
changes.1151-C6: General excise sections 96,97,109 B and 109 O assess common alcohol movement and small-wine exceptions. The 2020 Article 15 change updates the framework citation; equal treatment of wine references for OFBs was already present. No new 2020 product-scope omission inferred. Optional specified-wine intermediate reduction not separately exercised.
changes.1151-C7: No small-producer intermediate-product reduction is exercised in current Schedule 2. The new option is not mandatory.
changes.1151-C8: Country-specific Bulgarian/Czech/Polish and French/Greek options do not apply. Section 77 private beer/wine/OFB relief assessed; the new optional own-fruit spirit exemption is not separately exercised.
changes.1151-C9: Not applicable: options specifically for France and Greece.
changes.1151-C10: Current 78 B permits self-declaration for all five categories and annual output. Actual Revenue manual sections 1.9 and 5.9–5.11 recognise foreign certification or self-certification and current e-AD/e-SAD references. Actual requests, acceptance decisions and administrative practice are outside this assessment.
changes.1151-C11: Not applicable to national legislation: Commission implementing power.
changes.1151-C12: Current 77(c),(d) expressly cover foreign denaturing and manufacturing-equipment cleaning/maintenance. SI 379/2004 regulations 32–38 retain approval/use formalities; general 109 O provides completely-denatured movement treatment. Higher statutory right and consistent interpretation are material alternatives to an outdated-formality allegation; no actual refusal established.
changes.1151-C13: Current 73 medicinal-product definition references 2001/82 and 2001/83, including amending/replacing directives; section 77 manufacture exemption assessed.
changes.1151-C14: Optional 150 ml food-supplement exemption is not separately exercised; existing medicine/food exemptions assessed without treating the option as mandatory.
changes.1151-C15: Actual national denaturant approval, notified foreign complete-denaturing and control provisions read. Individual notifications, anti-abuse refusals and Commission performance are outside current-law assessment.
changes.1151-C17: Commission powers and conditional Member-State information duties do not independently require a national substantive rule. Actual reporting performance not audited.
changes.1151-C18: Current target provisions and authentic material commencement orders assessed. Historical EU-reference/publication and communication performance is not certified. Simplified amendment-table dates were not used where authentic commencement orders differed.
